Package integration

Class EmailService

java.lang.Object
integration.EmailService
public class EmailService extends Object
Service class for all email communications. Centralizes messaging logic for confirmations, reminders, and waitlist notifications. All emails are sent asynchronously in separate threads to avoid blocking the main execution.

      Sends a polite departure reminder when the dining time slot has ended. Centralizes the professional phrasing within the service to encourage guests to settle their bill. * @param res The Reservation entity for the customer being notified.

    • sendConfirmationEmail

      public static void sendConfirmationEmail(Reservation res)
      Sends a reservation confirmation email to the customer. Includes the reservation date, time, number of guests, and the unique confirmation code. * @param res The Reservation entity containing details for the confirmation.

      public static void sendPreArrivalReminder(Reservation res)

    • sendTableReadyNotification

      public static void sendTableReadyNotification(Reservation res)
      Sends an urgent email notification to a customer on the waitlist, informing them that a table has become available. The email includes the confirmation code for check-in and warns that the reservation will expire if they do not arrive within 15 minutes. * @param res The Reservation entity for the customer being notified.
